answer_4.quote: three human annotators are asked to annotate the evaluations for each pair of text prompt and image, following our proposed task decomposition evaluation framework.
answer_4.guideline: annotators follow the task decomposition evaluation framework to evaluate visual appearance, intrinsic attribute consistency, and relationship attribute consistency with structured questions and scoring from 0 to 10.
